Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.26.4:

- OS / Browser Support Matrix now covers two separate endpoint agents via an agent switch: the F1E Agent (DLP / Web — Windows, macOS, VDI, Browsers, Critical Notes as before) and the new FDC Classification Agent. The FDC tab tracks OS support plus per-OS Microsoft Office support flags (Microsoft 365, Office 2024, Office 2021, Office 2019, Office 2016).
- Agent Compatibility (wizard) now runs for DSPM and Classification scope too. When DSPM or Classification is selected, a dedicated FDC Classification Agent panel lets you pick the customer's OS environment and Office flavours and shows per-OS / per-Office support with findings for uncertified OS, EoS OS, and unsupported Office combinations.
- Earlier in this series: DSPM + FDC Product Lifecycle pages and auto-populated DSPM/FDC version rows in Version & EoS.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
